properties.value: hash.js 1.1.3 (SHA-256/SHA-1/RIPEMD-160 implementations) declared as elliptic's hashing dependency inside the ethers/ethereum-waffle toolchain — SHA-256 and RIPEMD-160 are needed for secp256k1 public-key-to-address derivation. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile declaration of the secp256k1 npm package (v4.0.1) plus @types stubs, transitively under ethereum-waffle/ganache-core in the hardhat dev toolchain. secp256k1 ECDSA is Ethereum's account-signature curve — every transaction the test harness sends is signed over it. Quantum-unsafe under Shor, but the curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol, not this repo. Dev-only: package.json declares zero runtime dependencies, so nothing here ships to consumers of this Solidity library.

Presence-only declaration: no call site in this Solidity library or its JS tests; the weak MD5 KDF is only reachable through ganache internals. Dev-only, not shipped.

properties.value: tweetnacl 1.0.3 declares X25519 (crypto_box key agreement) in the lockfile, pulled in by the ganache/truffle dev chain. Presence-only declaration; no call site in the Solidity product or its JS tests. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement, dev-toolchain reach only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @ethersproject/keccak256 and the keccak npm package — Keccak-256, Ethereum's protocol hash (pre-FIPS SHA-3 padding) — the backbone of the ethers/hardhat toolchain (ABI encoding, function selectors, address derivation). The shipped contracts also depend on keccak256 at the protocol level via extcodehash (address-utils.sol). Dev-only dependency; keccak256 itself is Grover-only (no Shor break), low PQ urgency, and protocol-fixed by Ethereum.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 55 sites inspected (3 pages): lockfile dependency declarations of three families — the pbkdf2 npm package v3.0.x (pulled via ganache-core/ganache-cli bip39 and crypto-browserify for mnemonic-to-seed and keystore derivation), @ethersproject/pbkdf2 5.5.0 (ethers v5 keystore/BIP39 wordlists), and @types/pbkdf2 typings. PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 is quantum-resilient as a KDF; it exists here only in the dev toolchain — the Solidity contracts and tests invoke nothing directly.

properties.value: tweetnacl 1.0.3 secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption) declared in the lockfile via the ganache/truffle dev chain. Presence-only; no call site in this repo's own code. Dev-only.
